visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with neatly styled dark hair, wearing a light grey denim overshirt, white t-shirt, and white cargo pants, walks confidently along a city sidewalk. He approaches the glass entrance of a luxury store named 'Chiaplio Vista'. The exterior environment is bright under natural daylight, featuring a textured beige wall and gold signage. (2) Inside the store, the man gestures toward arched, illuminated display niches holding various high-end skincare bottles and jars. He moves through a sophisticated lounge area with white marble coffee tables and grey upholstered seating. The indoor setting is characterized by warm, soft recessed lighting and minimalist, modern architectural elements. (3) A female staff member in a white professional uniform presents a warm towel on a wooden tray to the man. Seated on a plush white sofa with colorful geometric pillows, he takes the towel to wipe his hands while maintaining a pleasant facial expression. Nearby objects include glass water bottles and ceramic tea cups on the table. (4) The man enters a specialized treatment room where the dark ceiling is decorated with twinkling LED lights mimicking a starry night sky. He changes into a thick white bathrobe and prepares for a facial. He lies down on a professional massage bed under a warm spotlight as a staff member applies skincare products to his face.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bright, uplifting acoustic guitar melody and a steady, rhythmic percussion beat. A male narrator introduces the Taipei location with a friendly, high-energy tone and excellent articulation clarity. The vocal pitch is dynamic, conveying welcoming enthusiasm as the store's exterior environment is presented. (2) A subtle thud occurs as a staff member places a tray on the table. The narrator continues describing luxury skincare brands with consistent speech intensity and moderate speed. The BGM provides a cheerful, professional texture that remains perfectly balanced with the vocals, with no significant noise interference. (3) A soft clinking sound of glass is heard when a bottle is handled. The speaker's tone remains relaxed but authoritative while detailing specific service offerings. The music maintains its steady major-mode tempo, reinforcing a positive, high-end commercial atmosphere throughout the middle segment of the video. (4) The narration reaches a persuasive conclusion as the speaker describes the starry ceiling in the treatment room. The speech density remains high as he invites viewers to visit the spa. The audio track concludes with a gentle fade-out of the narrator's final recommendation and the instrumental music.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional endorsement for 'Chiaplio Vista', a luxury skincare center in Taipei. By showcasing the upscale interior, high-end Swiss product lines, and unique starry-night-themed treatment rooms, the content aims to attract a high-spending demographic seeking a professional and aesthetic beauty experience.
